payload.summary: npm run build fails in the Windows shell (build:internal uses POSIX NODE_OPTIONS=${...} expansion)
payload.detail: Found 2026-10-21 on the owner's Windows PC: latest main builds cleanly via bash (about 15 min) but npm run build fails in the Windows shell because build:internal sets NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:---max-old-space-size=8192}", which cmd and PowerShell do not expand. Workaround: build from bash. Fix: move the env default into a small Node wrapper (no new cross-env dependency). Touches the Railway Docker build and CI heavy scope, so it was kept out of the test-only #3745.
payload.source: Main CI and test reliability thread, 2026-10-21
